written.headline: Love Is War Drops 171.88 While Mikhawk Benches a 39.46-Point Maye
written.subhead: Love is War posts the week's high score in a 91.34-point demolition, and mikhawk loses by 4.58 with Drake Maye on the bench.
lead: Week 5 gave us a blowout, a heartbreaker, and a few upsets, and the blowout came first. Love is War (Miryth) hung 171.88 on Jared's Big Papa, who managed 80.54 for austinmorg. The 91.34-point margin was the week's biggest. Parker Washington put up 30.40, Malik Nabers added 29.10, and Jacoby Brissett chipped in 26.28 at quarterback. Brock Purdy led the Big Papa side with 17.16, which is not a number that wins anything.

That win lifts Love is War to 2-3 and eighth place, a record that looks wrong next to a league-best 690.40 points scored. The team is scoring like a contender and sitting like a middle-of-the-pack club. If the points keep coming, the wins should follow. Jared's Big Papa fell to 2-3 and 11th, and austinmorg could have used the 11.30 he left on the bench when Blake Corum (16.20) sat while Omarion Hampton (4.90) started. It wouldn't have saved him, but it would have been nice.

Now the tragedy. RomoCop (connal69) edged mikhawk 152.52 to 147.94, a 4.58-point nailbiter. Mikhawk had Drake Maye on the bench for 39.46 while Trevor Lawrence started and scored 22.74. That is a 16.72-point swing in a game decided by 4.58, and it is the Bench Blunder of the Week with the receipt attached. Mikhawk's 147.94 would have beaten 10 of the 13 other teams this week, and it still sits at 1-4. That's a Bad Beat of the Week for the ages, and a lesson in checking your lineup.

At the top, GopherDeeznuts (JorgusFantussy) is 4-1 and alone in first after a 147.20 to 87.80 win over THE crab warriors. Josh Allen scored 31.50, and the freshly added San Francisco 49ers defense chipped in 20.00. They Laported the Nabers (lakesleeper) have won three straight and climbed three spots to third. Bower Rangers, ranked 12th, knocked off second-ranked madmaxwellog49 in the week's biggest upset, and madmaxwellog49 has now lost two in a row.

1.headline: Love Is War Posts the Week's High Score, 171.88
1.body: Love is War (Miryth) beat Jared's Big Papa 171.88 to 80.54, and the 91.34-point margin was the biggest of the week. Parker Washington (30.40), Malik Nabers (29.10), and Jacoby Brissett (26.28) did the damage. austinmorg left Blake Corum's 16.20 on the bench for Omarion Hampton's 4.90, which hurt but did not change the outcome.

2.headline: Bower Rangers Topple the Second Seed
2.body: Bower Rangers (JaredFishkin), ranked 12th, beat second-ranked madmaxwellog49 148.12 to 123.34. Christian Watson led the way with 32.30, and Matthew Stafford (27.32) and Brock Bowers (23.00) helped. JaredFishkin started David Montgomery (1.10) over MarShawn Lloyd (16.70) and still won, while madmaxwellog49 got 28.94 from waiver gem Jared Goff and lost its second straight.

3.headline: AMBULANCE! Rolls Past Olichode
3.body: AMBULANCE! (ChrisV6), ranked 11th, beat fifth-ranked Olichode 128.14 to 91.32. Bucky Irving scored 31.50, Jameis Winston added 25.74, and Tyler Warren chipped in 21.40. Isaiah Likely posted 32.40 for Olichode, but nobody else on the roster got past Drake London's 18.80.

4.headline: RomoCop Survives Mikhawk's Bench Blunder by 4.58
4.body: RomoCop (connal69) beat mikhawk 152.52 to 147.94 on the strength of Puka Nacua's 37.70, the week's top player score, plus Trey McBride's 21.60. Mikhawk got 36.80 from Jaylen Warren and 28.00 from George Pickens, but Drake Maye sat on the bench with 39.46 while Trevor Lawrence started for 22.74. That 16.72-point gap was far bigger than the margin of defeat. RomoCop left some points on its own bench too, with C.J. Stroud's 20.94 behind Kirk Cousins' 13.72.

5.headline: GopherDeeznuts Take Sole Possession of First
5.body: GopherDeeznuts (JorgusFantussy) beat THE crab warriors 147.20 to 87.80 and moved to 4-1. Josh Allen scored 31.50, Jaxon Smith-Njigba added 22.80, and the 49ers defense came up big with 20.00. Crab warriors got 19.80 from Sam LaPorta but started Deebo Samuel (2.50) over Wan'Dale Robinson (11.30).

6.headline: Let Him Cook Wins Despite a Questionable Lineup
6.body: Let Him Cook (JerryMick) beat jjssrrgg 108.70 to 77.94. James Cook scored 22.80, Aaron Rodgers 22.00, and Matthew Golden 20.30. That 108.70 would have beaten only 4 of the other 13 teams, which makes it the Lucky Win of the Week, and JerryMick started Carnell Tate (1.60) while Emeka Egbuka (17.20) sat. jjssrrgg posted the week's low score, lost its third straight, and got a 0.00 from Brian Thomas, the Dud of the Week.

7.headline: They Laported the Nabers Make It Three Straight
7.body: They Laported the Nabers (lakesleeper) beat Boomer Sooner 136.30 to 112.86 for a third straight win. Jahmyr Gibbs scored 37.70, Joe Burrow 24.60, and Ja'Marr Chase 19.70. Mike Evans led Boomer Sooner (iiSilverhammer) with 26.30, but it wasn't enough to avoid the loss.

column.title: Check Your Bench, Folks
body: Mikhawk, I have news that nobody wants to hear: Drake Maye scored 39.46 points on your bench. You started Trevor Lawrence (22.74) and lost by 4.58. Your 147.94 would have beaten 10 of the 13 other teams this week, and you're 1-4 anyway, 14th in the standings. It's the kind of loss that makes a manager stare at the wall. This column will sit with you in this moment, and then ask you to set your lineup earlier next time.

Elsewhere, a few reminders about what the waiver wire can do. Jared Goff, picked up for a bid of 150 in Week 2, has 68.78 points over 3 starts, and he gave madmaxwellog49 another 28.94 this week. It wasn't enough against Bower Rangers, but he's still our Waiver Wonder. Meanwhile, Love is War leads the league in points scored (690.40) and sits 2-3, which is the most Helmet Brigade thing I can think of. That kind of scoring doesn't stay unlucky forever, so expect Miryth to climb.

Finally, the trade desk. Love is War and Boomer Sooner swapped entire draft boards back in Week 1, rounds 1 through 14, and we'll be watching how that plays out. The Week 4 Ja'Marr Chase trade is tracked at 25.40 for They Laported the Nabers against 33.50 from DK Metcalf and Chris Olave for mikhawk, an 8.10 edge for mikhawk. Chase did his part this week with 19.70, and I'd love to know how the other side's receivers did. Mikhawk, check that bench first.

storylines: Love is War leads the league with 690.40 points scored but sits 2-3 and eighth after a 171.88-point week.
Mikhawk is 1-4 after losing by 4.58 with Drake Maye (39.46) on the bench, and the score would have beaten 10 of 13 other teams.
They Laported the Nabers have won three straight and moved up to third at 3-2.
GopherDeeznuts hold first place at 4-1 after adding the 49ers defense.
jjssrrgg has lost three straight and posted the week's low score of 77.94.
The Week 4 Chase trade is tracked in mikhawk's favor by 8.10, and the Week 3 Loveland/Vele swap favors Boomer Sooner by 8.20.
